remarks: Experience Luxury Waterfront Living at The Beacon at Harbor Point  Discover Stamford's premier luxury waterfront high-rise, The Beacon at Harbor Point. Offering beautifully appointed finishes, each residence features stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, quartz countertops, a full-size in-unit washer and dryer, and spacious open layouts designed for modern living.  Enjoy resort-style amenities, including a 24-hour concierge, a state-of-the-art fitness center with cutting-edge cardio and weight-training equipment, a game room with billiards, a swimming pool, and outdoor fire pits for relaxation. Take in breathtaking views from the observatory deck 22 stories up, work from the around-the-clock workspace, and take advantage of the shuttle service to the train and a complimentary water taxi for seamless connectivity.  Located in the heart of Harbor Point, The Beacon provides direct access to public parks, marinas, and a scenic boardwalk. Experience a vibrant community with over 200 events year-round, including yoga on the boardwalk, 5K races, outdoor movies, farmers markets, seasonal pop-ups, and more.  Live where luxury meets lifestyle at The Beacon at Harbor Point
